summary: Iteration 13 — Batch A of critical fixes. FULL PASS on the 5 P0 frontend tests plus all 9 backend regressions. Cleaned Alex's test data first (deleted 1 residual linked_accounts, 16 bank_transactions, 2 coaching_bookings, 3 payment_transactions; unset premium_expires_at). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases green — POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me, POST /api/auth/forgot-password (dev-fallback returns reset_token as SENDGRID is empty), POST /api/auth/reset-password with token → NewPass123! login → reset back to password123, POST /api/accounts/simplefin/link (demo token scraped from beta-bridge.simplefin.org — 3 accounts linked totalling $140,689.98), GET /api/accounts/all, GET /api/payments/products, POST /api/payments/checkout (coaching_session with future scheduled_at → checkout.stripe.com URL), POST /api/payments/checkout (jaleter_premium → checkout.stripe.com URL). Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844, localhost:3000 after page.evaluate localStorage.clear()): (T1) Budget editable — Give expanded by default, Tithe row shows 'tap to set' in gold, tap opens sheet titled 'Set budget · Tithe', typing 500 and 'Save amount' closes sheet and row now reads '$500 / budgeted', Give card total shows 'of $500'. Full page reload persists $500. ✅ (T2) Sync banner — empty state banner reads exactly 'No accounts linked yet' / 'Link a bank via Settings → Linked Accounts, or import a CSV.' with amber tint; 'No transactions yet' empty state visible. Never contains 'SimpleFIN sync is current'. After linking 3 demo SimpleFIN accounts via backend, banner switches to green '3 accounts synced' / 'Last sync never.' ⚠️ (see minor). ✅ (T3) Net Worth aggregation — Hero $140,690 = sum of linked balances ($115,105.51 + $25,584.47 + $0 = $140,689.98 rounded). Assets card has exactly 4 rows: Cash, Investments, Real Estate, Vehicles. Cash row source reads 'SimpleFIN · 3 accounts' with value $140,690. No extra per-account rows below Vehicles. Sub-hero subtitle now reads 'Live from 3 linked accounts' (was 'Updates with your linked accounts'). ✅ (T4) Home mirrors — Home snapshot 'Net Worth $140,690' = Net Worth hero exactly. ✅ (T5) Reset App Data — Settings → 'Reset App Data' → confirm. No crash. Budget returns to $0 across all subcategories. Transactions list shows 'No transactions yet.'. Net Worth still $140,690 because server-side linked accounts remain (banner still says '3 accounts synced'). ✅. Screenshots saved at /app/test_reports/screenshots/. Alex's password restored to password123 and all test artifacts cleaned before finishing.

ui_bugs.issue: Immediately after POST /api/accounts/simplefin/link, GET /api/accounts/all returns last_sync_at=null for every account, so the banner reads '3 accounts synced · Last sync never.' The request spec expected 'Last sync just now'. Root cause: server does not stamp last_sync_at on link creation, only on POST /api/accounts/sync. Fix (frontend): treat null last_sync_at as 'just now' when accounts exist. OR (backend): stamp last_sync_at on link creation. index.tsx:1040-1061.

Cash row shows 'SimpleFIN · 3 accounts' when demo org_name is empty string. In production with real banks this would show 'SimpleFIN · <org_name>' (correct). Demo/development quirk only — not a real bug but worth noting for the client demo.

react_native_issues.issue: Same RN-Web deprecation warnings as iterations 10–12: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carried, no new occurrences.

action_items: OPTIONAL P3 (cosmetic): index.tsx:1042-1061 — after linking, last_sync_at is null so banner reads 'Last sync never.' — expected 'just now'. Either treat null last_sync_at + linked > 0 as 'just now', or have the backend stamp last_sync_at on link creation.
OPTIONAL P3 (deprecations, carried): migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents.

OPTIONAL — Reset App Data intentionally does NOT log the user out (auth token remains in secure-store), only wipes the local jaleter-state-v2 cache. Verified. If a user restarts the app after reset, they stay logged in with a $0 budget. Good behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx:868 — expanded state defaults to ['give'] so Give is expanded on first render. A test-selector convenience but worth noting; tests must NOT click budget-cat-give to expand — that would collapse it.

index.tsx:1179-1182 — displayAssets is now strictly 4 rows (Cash, Investments, Real Estate, Vehicles) with linked balances aggregated into Cash/Investments via sum(manual + linked). Verified correct with demo — no double-counting, no per-account row appended. Nice fix.
index.tsx:1873-1883 — MainApp includes linkedAssetsTotal in netWorth calc, ensuring Home and Net Worth agree. Verified $140,690 identical on both screens.
index.tsx:1916-1924 — onResetAppData clears jaleter-state-v2 + legacy keys and resets categories/income/experience/appearance/alerts but does NOT touch auth. Correct behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For frontend E2E Stripe redirect testing, MUST use the preview URL (https://no-changes-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com), NOT http://localhost:3000, because backend builds Stripe success_url from x-forwarded-host (documented in iteration_12). For all NON-Stripe UI tests, http://localhost:3000 works fine (used here). Demo SimpleFIN setup tokens are scraped from beta-bridge.simplefin.org/info/developers — one-shot, refresh for new. After demo link the API returns last_sync_at=null (linked_count=3, org_name=''). Budget state is stored in localStorage under key 'jaleter-state-v2' plus one legacy 'jaleter-state-v1'; Reset App Data clears both. Auth token in secure-store is NOT cleared by Reset. Bottom nav does not currently have testIDs — use page.locator('text=Budget').last / 'Net Worth'.last / 'Transactions'.last for navigation. Give budget category is expanded by default (expanded=['give']) — do NOT click budget-cat-give to expand or it will collapse.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues found this iteration. The single cosmetic quirk (Last sync 'never' right after link) is caused by /api/accounts/all returning last_sync_at=null in the account rows immediately after POST /api/accounts/simplefin/link (backend only stamps last_sync_at when POST /api/accounts/sync runs). formatAgo(0) at index.tsx:1042-1051 returns 'never', so the fresh-link banner reads 'Last sync never.' rather than 'just now'. Two-line fix in the banner builder or a one-line fix in the SimpleFIN link handler on the backend.
